name: figma_write

arguments.code: const ds = await figma.generateDesignSystem({ style: 'neutral', hue: 250, components: ['Primitives/Button','Forms/Input','Data/Card'] }); return { components: ds.components, failed: ds.failed, contrast: ds.contrastFindings };

note: the design-system generator, three components only

name: figma_write

arguments.code: const found = await figma.findComponent('Button'); if (!found.matches.length) return { skipped: 'no Button' }; const inst = await figma.instantiate(found.matches[0].id, { props: { Size: 'md' } }); return { made: inst.ids, available: inst.availableProperties, props: inst.instances[0].properties };

note: find + instantiate with props — the variant two-pass path
